name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Good evening. Seven captains, every unit covered, Stefanski confirmed it himself. Mike, Andrew, tell me why that structure equals identity and not just paperwork.

name: BIG MIKE VEGA
line: Renee, Stefanski didn't just fill slots...he launched the ENTRANCE! The Falcons' own words: captains represent the identity. This roster IS that identity, walking out loud!

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: Right.

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: Look, Mike, I hear you, and the Falcons themselves say leadership comes in many forms. So while these seven are great, it's a big roster, and folks are wondering if the net was cast wide enough.

name: BIG MIKE VEGA
line: Andrew, a wide net? This is the TITLE TEAM walkout! Folk on special teams, Bates and Deablo on D, Lindstrom on O...that coverage IS the championship energy, announced!

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: Mike, the Falcons themselves said leadership comes in many forms, not just the seven names on that list. That's straight from the source, and it tells you something.

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Mm.

name: BIG MIKE VEGA
line: Renee, that 'mm' is the quiet before the STADIUM EXPLODES! The Falcons say captains represent the identity – and with Folk, Bates, Deablo, Lindstrom, that identity is COVERED AND CONFIRMED!

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Mike, coverage isn't the same as consensus. Andrew's point stands: the team's own words leave room for leaders outside that list, so what's your answer to that, not the volume?

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: Mm.

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: Renee’s right, Mike. The team themselves has said leadership isn't just about the guys wearing the C. You need to account for more than just seven names.

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Right.

name: BIG MIKE VEGA
line: Renee, Andrew – 'many forms'? In a title fight, you don't need a committee! The Falcons said captains REPRESENT the identity – this is that identity, ANNOUNCED!

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: Right.

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Mike, you keep announcing it louder instead of naming who got left off. If the net's wide enough, give me the name that proves it.

name: BIG MIKE VEGA
line: Renee, the missing name doesn't matter! With Folk, Bates, Deablo, Lindstrom, every unit is represented – that's the identity, LOUD AND CLEAR!

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: So the missing name doesn't matter, but the wide net does. You can't have it both ways, Mike.

name: BIG MIKE VEGA
line: Renee, last show you called the coverage clean! Now you question it? That coverage IS the Falcon identity, and identity wins rings!

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Mm.

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: Look, Renee's got a point. When the organization itself states that leadership takes many forms, you can't just limit it to a handful of guys, no matter how good they are.

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: That's fair, and I'll say it plainly: structure is confirmed, consensus on 'best' isn't. We'll see who leads once the games start counting.
